requirement: Publish tab: Connect domain on a draft site asks to publish first instead of opening the domain form; Back to draft warns, per connected domain, that its visitors no longer reach the site

oracle.ref: PR #1291 (feat); fix evidence: Vincent, 13/10/2026: Connect domain on a draft site should say the site must be published first; Back to draft after a domain is connected should warn that the domain stops working.
oracle.invariant: S1 exits 0 with 0 failures. On a draft site, pressing [data-action="connect-domain"] opens no form[data-form] and opens a [role="alertdialog"] holding domains.publishFirstTitle and domains.publishFirstBody; no POST go-live is sent by that press. Pressing [data-confirm="live"] in that dialog sends exactly one POST go-live with body {"op":"live"} and the dialog closes; Cancel closes it and sends nothing. On a live site, Connect domain still opens form[data-form="domain"]. Back to draft on a live site with a connected domain shows domains.draftStops naming that domain on a [data-line="draft-domain"] line that carries the class tv-domain-note-alert.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
